source_books: كتاب الطالب لمادة اللغة الإنجليزية للصف الخامس الفصل الثاني (g5-eng-s2-student-book, Jordan Team Together series, Pearson/York Press)
دليل المعلم لمادة اللغة الإنجليزية للصف الخامس الفصل الثاني (g5-eng-s2-teacher-guide) — read 2026-11-13 for the lesson structure only
meta.provenance_note: Read directly from the PDF via PyMuPDF on 2026-09-16 — clean extraction, same as Semester 1 (iqra_curriculum_g5_english_sem1.json). Unit titles, page numbers, vocabulary, grammar structures and skill descriptors were taken from the book's own 'Scope and sequence' table (pp. 4-5). Lesson structure, titles and aims: the teacher's guide, read lesson by lesson on 2026-11-13 (see known_gaps).
known_gaps: Since 2026-11-13 every unit carries the book's own lessons, read lesson by lesson from the teacher's guide (Objectives block and heading of each lesson): Welcome back = 3 lessons, each main unit = 12 (1 PB Vocabulary, 2 AB Vocabulary, 3 PB Story, 4 AB Story, 5 PB Grammar, 6 AB Grammar, 7 PB Vocabulary and Grammar with the song, 8 AB Vocabulary and Grammar, 9 Culture + project, 10 English in action + Pronunciation, 11 Reading, 12 Listening, Speaking and Writing). `order` is the book lesson number. The ids are NOT: u*_l1 and u*_l2 were the old two lessons and their ids are persisted, so u*_l1 = book Lesson 1 (Vocabulary) and u*_l2 = book Lesson 12 (Welcome back: Lesson 3), and the new u*_l3…u*_l12 are book Lessons 2–11 (Welcome back: u*_l3 = Lesson 2). Objective ids are positional and stored with exam questions, so u*_l1/u*_l2 keep their original objectives first and the lesson's own aims follow. u*_l1 keeps the whole unit's word list (it is the English corner lesson and the grammar unit is keyed on it); each later lesson names the words it introduces in its objectives ("New words: …") rather than in `vocabulary`, so the corner still has one lesson per unit.

Units are numbered 6-10 here, continuing Semester 1's 1-5. This does NOT match the book: its contents page prints Welcome back (W), then 5 Animals in danger, 6 Staying healthy, 7 Curtain up!, 8 Let's get creative! — so the book's Unit 5 is u7 here, and the book's 'Unit 6' is u8 (corrected 2026-11-13; this line used to say the numbering matched the book).

Excluded as supplementary, non-core material: the 'Bo's Learning Club' boosters, the cross-curricular spreads (Art: What do landscape paintings look like?; Social Studies: How are the continents different?), 'Festivals' pages (Youth Service Day, World Heritage Day), 'Solve it', and the 'Grammar reference' appendix.

Vocabulary corrected 2026-11-13: 'fit'/'unfit' were listed twice in u8_l1 (as vocabulary and as pronunciation words) and the second pair was removed. The u10 pronunciation set also prints 'seeing' and 'watching'; they are named in u10_l1's objectives rather than added as vocabulary, because every vocabulary word is drilled and voiced in the English corner.

Story titles: only Unit 1's story prints a title in the extracted text («Watch out for the cat!»); the other stories are titled from the teacher's guide's own plot summary. Songs without a printed title are identified by their first or chorus line.
